The goal is to accurately measure the duration for refitting the best estimator on the full dataset after performing grid or random search. This functionality is especially important when running on multiple cores, where the traditional method of subtracting fold fit times from the overall search time is no longer applicable. The new attribute, refit_time_, should capture the exact seconds taken to refit the best model.

Pay attention to the condition when refit is enabled so that the timing is recorded only when appropriate.
